fields.System.Title: Add Pricefx quick-launch tile to the Salesforce home page
fields.Custom.UserStoryorProblemStatement:
As a Sales Team Member,
I want a quick-launch tile
so that I can open Pricefx without searching.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
1. Tile appears on the Salesforce home page.
  2. Clicking it opens Pricefx in a new tab.
fields.WebTechScrum.TestScenarios:
Setup: Assign the Pricefx User permission set.

1. Open the Salesforce home page.
2. Confirm the Pricefx tile is visible.
